scope: Phase A harvested asset wiring audit and representative proof

wired_definition.imported: A row exists in the relevant live manifest/index.
wired_definition.addressable: The row exists and its referenced live file exists.
wired_definition.generator_eligible: A current selector may return it without bypassing family, safety, sharpness, or specialization gates.
wired_definition.prop_path: 09_props manifest -> PropBank index -> identity/pack/role selector -> VocabArt or activity/story renderer.
wired_definition.harvested_path: Inventory family -> rule -> existing importer -> manifest/index -> selector eligibility or explicit exception.

discrepancy_explanation: The ~5,100 figure is a planning estimate, while verified_unwired counts unique logical inventory keys with surviving source evidence and no exact live address.
One harvested PNG is often a 3x3, 4x4, 4x8, or mixed contact sheet, so PNG file counts and logical asset counts are intentionally different.
Mop/recovery inventories repeat original keys; this audit de-duplicates by logical key and keeps the strongest source/live evidence.
Inventory-only rows with no surviving exact file or family sheet are ESTIMATED_UNWIRED but not VERIFIED_UNWIRED.
Exact keys already present in 07/08/09 are removed from unwired counts even when their harvested source remains.

mapping.RAW: Surviving harvested PNG evidence exists; this does not imply QA or usability.
mapping.IMPORTED: An exact logical key has a row in 07_vocab, 08_backgrounds, or 09_props.
mapping.ADDRESSABLE: The live row points to an existing file.
mapping.GENERATOR_ELIGIBLE: Current generic selectors may return it after safety/identity/sharpness checks.
mapping.SPECIALIZED: Usable only by its named mechanic, pack, sequence, state family, or relationship-aware selector.
mapping.REFERENCE_ONLY: Metadata/source is intentionally preserved but generic generation must not select it.
mapping.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Identity, QA, route, or family semantics need a human/family rule before merge.
mapping.HOLD: A required planner/renderer/state mechanic does not exist or the stockpile is explicitly closed.
mapping.JUNK: Known failed/rejected source; never import or use as a variant.

family_rules.note: Already recovered/imported zoom scenes. Verify only; never remanufacture.
A contact sheet is a coordinated view family, not one generic background.
Same-camera state ladders require a state mechanic; they are not viewpoints.
Closed stockpile. Keep out of generic PropBank/background selectors.
Instruction, TPR, phonology, and tracing mechanics need explicit renderers.
Structural classroom mechanics stay specialized until a renderer requests them.
Routes, transactions, information gaps, and prosody overlays need mechanics.
Relationship/discourse visuals are not generic props.
Argument and mediation visuals require explicit planner semantics.
Grammar relationships need named slots; do not leak them into object picks.
Named black-field cells stage, QA, then merge into 09_props.
Sequence plates may be addressable backgrounds but stay sequence-specialized.
Only obvious full-page landscapes may enter 08_backgrounds.
Unknown board-enabling families fail closed until explicitly classified.
Only identity-clear, dock-sharp cells become generic PropBank rows.
Target an existing vocab identity; never register redo-* as a new word.
Mixed props/scenes/overlays must be split by family before import.

representative_families.route: relationship registry only; generic background scan blocked
